why: Same objects on both sides (P.Level m with P.levelTopology m, which is the project's instance; X_∞ = P.SmoothLevel). B gives X_∞ the infimum of the topologies induced by the inclusions X_∞ → X_m; the project's instance is induced from the product ∏ X_m, and the two agree (smoothLevel_topology_eq, re-proved in B ⇒ A by induced_iInf/induced_compose). A additionally states 'X is metrizable' (separately from the levels) and 'every subset of X is paracompact'; both follow from B at m = 0 via the homeomorphism X ≃ X_0 (toBase 0 = id, so the level-0 generators φ⁻¹(W) are open in X; isEmbedding_levelZero), so they are the text's m = 0 case, not extra content. All A conjuncts instantiated at universe 0; SmoothLevel is a definition (vocabulary) and is not in A.
